{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsor shock system''' was a type of suspension used by the [[RES-Q Airspeeder]]. It stabilized the vehicle during flight, giving patients being transported in the speeder a smooth ride.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
